lead_raw_text:
The cubic crystal Li8Ag4Sn4 (reduced formula Li2AgSn) adopts space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements for all three elements: Ag and Sn centers each coordinate to eight Li neighbors, while Li centers coordinate to four Ag and four Sn neighbors, all at 2.8286 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Li–Li 8-vertex polyhedra with corner, edge, and face sharing, while Ag–Sn polyhedra share corners and faces.
